How a project runs

Most new homes take two to three years from first visit to keys. Renovations and interiors are quicker. You'll always know which stage you're in and what comes next.

  1. 2–4 weeks

    Site and brief

    A day on site together, a measured survey and a written brief that we both sign off.

  2. 6–8 weeks

    Concept design

    Two or three options as models and sketches. We develop the one you choose.

  3. 8–16 weeks

    Planning and permits

    Drawings for planning approval and building permits, plus early contractor input on cost.

  4. 8–12 weeks

    Technical design

    Construction drawings, specifications and the interior schedule, ready to tender.

  5. 6–18 months

    On site

    We visit weekly, answer the contractor's questions and keep the budget in view until handover.
